summary.text: Brad Trahan is the Republican candidate for the Minnesota House of Representatives, District 25A, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A Rochester recruiter and disability advocate, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he is running to protect taxpayer dollars, make Minnesota more affordable and strengthen public safety.

paragraphs.text: Trahan said in a Ballotpedia survey that Rochester has been his home for more than four decades and that he and his wife raised their family there.
He attended Mayo High School and lists his profession as recruiter.
He described a career in workforce development, community leadership, disability advocacy and volunteer service, and said he is the father of a son with severe autism.

Trahan's stated priorities include protecting taxpayer dollars, affordability, public safety, support for people with disabilities and their families, improving education outcomes, growing the economy and government transparency.
